requirement: NUL byte in decoded content must fail as a typed IngestionError
expected: IngestionError subclass raised by the engine
actual:
sqlalchemy.exc.DBAPIError: (sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.asyncpg.Error) <class 'asyncpg.exceptions.CharacterNotInRepertoireError'>: invalid byte sequence for encoding "UTF8": 0x00
[SQL: INSERT INTO configurations (id, device_id, filename, content_hash, raw_content, content_type, size_bytes, line_c
evidence: ingestion.py:198-216 decodes NUL as a normal latin-1/utf-8 character; PostgreSQL TEXT rejects U+0000 at flush (CharacterNotInRepertoireError) so the failure escapes as an untyped DBAPIError from a synchronous engine method that declares no error contract
recommendation: Reject control characters during decoding, or flush inside the engine and translate driver errors into IngestionError.

requirement: repeated ingestion of identical content behaves consistently
the production upload path must use the engine under validation
actual: imports_engine=False; 4 divergences: duplicate: endpoint RETURNS the existing row (configurations.py:103-109) while the engine RAISES DuplicateConfigurationError (ingestion.py:185-189) | decode: endpoint tries utf-8 -> latin-1 only (configurations.py:111-123); engine tries utf-8 -> latin-1 -> cp-1252 (ingestion.py:198-213) | extension: endpoint builds file_ext='' for extensionless names and raises HTTP 400 (configurations.py:82-87); engine raises InvalidFileExtensionError('Invalid filename') (ingestion.py:153-154) | ordering: endpoint buffers the whole body via await file.read() (configurations.py:90) BEFORE the size check (configurations.py:94)
evidence: grep across app/** and tests/** found ZERO imports of app.engines.ingestion; the only ingestion path actually exercised in production re-implements extension/size/hash/duplicate/decode inline with different semantics
recommendation: Either route the endpoint through IngestionEngine or delete the engine so a single ingestion contract exists.
